field_checks.summary: All 112 final activity rows were enumerated and their raw workbook values matched source cells, but 38 Supplementary Data 3 E. coli K88 MIC records set target_strain_or_isolate to 'not reported' despite the source header and MIC methods naming E. coli K88.

Four database audit records were reviewed. p15, p17, and p20 source sequences and lengths match the workbook, but all four DBAASP fallback rows remain unresolved because authoritative linked article, assay, sequence, and literature snapshots are empty; the final correctly keeps authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready false.

Shared paper-final and packet-final JSON mirrors are byte-identical for activity, database, mechanism, and review outputs; live packet ticket state is open_rework_ticket_count 0. This does not clear publication grade because source-level worker-2 field errors remain, and paper final has materials_manifest while packet final has an extra mechanism_evidence alias.

Mechanism evidence classes are not overpromoted: PI membrane permeability is the only direct_mechanism claim, while AlphaFold, physicochemical rationale, and MIC/growth phenotype are kept computational, inferred, or phenotype-supported. One mechanism supporting_source_locators entry is an analysis artifact path and is handled as a recursive-authority blocker under the release-boundary check.

Paper DOI, PMID, PMCID, title, journal, and year agree across source metadata and final records. Every object containing a plain one-letter sequence plus sequence_length was independently counted; 138 checked objects matched exactly, including p15=26, p17=29, and p20=32 residues.

Final locators and normalization are not publication-grade. Four excluded activity objects cite eight blank workbook cell locators not present in packet locator_index, and all 36 Supplementary Data 10 toxicity/selectivity rows mislabel log10 μg/mL source values as μM or log2; 18 MIC log columns are conflated as selectivity index.

Fallback release boundary is preserved, but recursive authority is not fully false: mechanism claim PMC12125351-MECH-004 lists packets/PMC12125351/analysis/activity_toxicity_evidence.worker2.json inside supporting_source_locators instead of keeping worker artifacts outside source-locator fields.

The p17/p20 P. aeruginosa prose-versus-workbook conflict is preserved with exact workbook values, and the authoritative DBAASP linked-row absence is preserved as a caution. These cautions are acceptable only if the worker-2 toxicity/target and worker-5 recursive locator defects are repaired.

All requested source paths were readable. Primary XML/PDF and all four staged supplements were independently inspected through source files and packet extracts: paper PDF 14 pages, Supplementary PDF text for MOESM1/MOESM3/MOESM4, workbook 12 sheets with 1042 nonempty rows and 15396 nonempty cells, and no archive members or extraction errors.

Toxicity/selectivity coverage count is complete but field-level source fidelity fails: 144 toxicity records set target_species to Homo sapiens even though source methods specify IEC-6 intestinal epithelial cells for cytotoxicity and rat erythrocytes for hemolysis, and Supplementary Data 10 reports log10 concentration values, not μM/log2 selectivity-index measurements.

blocking_findings.reason: The current final activity_toxicity_evidence.json cannot support publication-grade acceptance. Independent workbook/XML checks found 38 E. coli K88 MIC records with the strain omitted as 'not reported'; 36 Supplementary Data 10 rows whose source headers are log10 concentration values in μg/mL but final raw_unit/normalized_unit are μM or log2; 18 Supplementary Data 10 MIC log columns mislabeled as selectivity index; 144 toxicity rows with Homo sapiens as target_species although source methods say IEC-6 intestinal epithelial cells for cytotoxicity and rat erythrocytes for hemolysis; and four exclusion objects citing blank cell locators absent from packet locator_index.
required_actions: Rebuild activity records so every Supplementary Data 3 E. coli K88 MIC row carries K88 in target_strain_or_isolate and retains the exact source value/unit.

Rebuild toxicity records so Supplementary Data 10 B/C are log10(CC50[μg/mL]) and log10(HC50[μg/mL]) without μM conversion, and D/E are not labeled selectivity index unless an explicit source-backed calculation is added.
Replace unsupported Homo sapiens toxicity targets with source-faithful IEC-6 intestinal epithelial cells and rat erythrocytes fields; do not infer human species from generic mammalian wording.
Remove or convert blank-cell exclusion locators to packet-resolvable row locators or explicit non-locator exclusion notes.
acceptance_checks: A script over final activity_toxicity_evidence.json reports zero Supplementary Data 3 E. coli K88 records with target_strain_or_isolate='not reported'.
A script over final toxicity_records reports zero Supplementary Data 10 rows with raw_unit in {'μM','log2'} when raw_endpoint_label starts with log10.

A script over final toxicity_records reports zero Supplementary Data 10 rows with endpoint='selectivity index' unless the source locator points to an actual selectivity-index source value or a documented calculation field.
A script over final toxicity_records reports zero Homo sapiens target_species values for Supplementary Data 10-12 unless directly source-supported.
A locator-resolution script reports zero final source_locator values missing from packet locator_index, excluding documented database-only provenance.

blocking_findings.reason: The current mechanism final keeps evidence-strength classes mostly correct, but claim PMC12125351-MECH-004 places packets/PMC12125351/analysis/activity_toxicity_evidence.worker2.json inside supporting_source_locators. That is a worker artifact, not a primary source or packet source locator, so recursive authority is not false for the final mechanism record.
required_actions: Move worker artifact references out of supporting_source_locators into checked_inputs or provenance-only fields.

Replace the non-source supporting locator with primary XML/PDF/supplement locators for the phenotype claim, or explicitly mark activity artifact references as secondary analysis provenance outside source-locator fields.
Preserve the current direct PI boundary while ensuring every source_locator and supporting_source_locators entry is a source-resolvable xml, pdf, supp, or database locator.
acceptance_checks: A script over final mechanism_ontology_record.json reports zero strings in source_locator or supporting_source_locators containing '/analysis/', '/work/', '/final/', 'papers/', 'packets/', or absolute workspace paths.
A locator-resolution script confirms every mechanism source locator resolves in packet locator_index or is an explicitly documented database-only locator.
Mechanism claim counts remain one direct_mechanism PI claim, one computational_only claim, one inferred_mechanism claim, and one phenotype_supported claim.

cautions.summary: No authoritative DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP linked rows are present for this paper. The current final preserves the correct release boundary by keeping four fallback machine rows unresolved and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false.

The final preserves a source conflict: XML prose says AMP-17 and AMP-20 had P. aeruginosa MIC values above 25 μM, while Supplementary Data 4 gives exact paired values of 35.15625 μg/mL/9.96722061992234 μM for p17 and 70.3125 μg/mL/18.5789934940427 μM for p20.

Canonical shared final mirrors are byte-identical, but auxiliary final surfaces are asymmetric: materials_manifest.json exists only under papers/final, while mechanism_evidence.json exists only under packets/final as an alias of mechanism_ontology_record.json.
